newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss debt prices ended firmer in cautious trading that traders called the calm before the storm of Friday's U.S. August nonfarm payroll numbers.

A strong increase in the payrolls would likely heighten speculation that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates, possibly as soon as its next Federal Open Market Committee meeting on September 24.

The Swiss market showed it had decoupled from other bourses to some extent. Conf futures on Swiss government bonds mostly shrugged off news of initial U.S. unemployment claims even though U.S. bond yields rose.
Trading in CONF futures was dominated by roll-over activities ahead of the CONF expiry on Monday in two weeks.
